whyMatters.en: NYC noise-rock band that treated alternate tunings and prepared guitar as composition method; Daydream Nation (1988) is the indie landmark.
whyMatters.zh: 纽约 noise-rock：把另类调弦与预制吉他当作曲方法；Daydream Nation（1988）是 indie 地标。

shortBio.en: Moore / Gordon / Ranaldo noise-indie; Teen Age Riot opens Daydream Nation.
shortBio.zh: Moore / Gordon / Ranaldo 的 noise-indie；Teen Age Riot 打开 Daydream Nation。

body.en:
Formed 1981. Bad Moon Rising through Sister and Daydream Nation moved from No Wave residue to long-form indie with song hooks inside dissonance.

Teen Age Riot (1988) is the accessible gate. Influence runs through 1990s alternative and DIY: tunings as identity, feedback as arrangement, dual/triple guitar roles without classic-rock solos.
body.zh:
1981 年组建。从 Bad Moon Rising 到 Sister 与 Daydream Nation，从 No Wave 残余走到在不协和里仍有歌曲钩子的长篇 indie。

Teen Age Riot（1988）是易入口。影响贯穿 1990 年代 alternative 与 DIY：调弦即身份、反馈即编曲、双/三吉他角色而不走经典摇滚独奏。
